reason: Modifying the mount options for the /boot partition directly impacts the boot process. An incorrect fstab entry or missing /boot definition can render the system unbootable, requiring physical console access for recovery. Because this is a filesystem/bootloader related change, it is classified as too dangerous to remediate automatically.
estimated_impact: reboot required; filesystems affected; potential boot failure; system may become unbootable; loss of remote access until physical console is used
